concept.hr: Rasponi stavki nagnuti su prema prekoračenju; pričuva kupuje pouzdanost
concept.en: Line ranges lean towards overruns; the reserve buys a level of confidence

summary.hr: Zadaj raspone stavki projekta, pokreni mnogo pokusa, odaberi razinu pouzdanosti i pročitaj koliku pričuvu traži.
summary.en: Set ranges for the lines of a project estimate, run many trials, choose the confidence level and read the reserve it needs.
